heading: Everything your AV team needs.
intro: Forward this straight to facilities, AV, or the venue. The setup is small, practical, and built to fit around the event rather than take it over.
supportNote: Need a full, detailed rider to send to your sound technician? Here's a pdf to download.
documentSubtitle: Solo amplified cello with backing tracks. Compact technical requirements for corporate events.
advanceNote: Send the venue, guest count and run sheet to confirm the input, playback and monitoring plan in advance.

items.detail: Please provide one armless chair. No riser is required.
I bring a speaker for rooms of roughly 100 guests or fewer. For larger rooms and outdoor spaces, please provide a PA suited to the venue and guest count.
Clip-on instrument microphone to the desk via XLR or 6.35 mm jack. Requires 48 V phantom power. I carry a backup dynamic XLR microphone. Please tell me in advance if phantom power is unavailable.
Bluetooth is preferred for backing tracks, so I can adjust volume, song choice and set length as the room changes. A wired connection is fine when a sound technician is on the desk.
60 to 90 minutes before the first set.
Black tie, business formal, or an agreed dress code to represent your brand.
I need to hear both the cello and backing track through the venue PA, or through a monitor for large or outdoor venues.
